purpose: Diagnose the 2,552 Step 3D unaligned residual records using headers and event-group metadata only, and recommend at most one deterministic value-blind correction without implementing it.

predecessor_preservation.immutability_rule: Every predecessor verdict and sealed source, protocol, tool, result, report, and manifest remains byte-for-byte unchanged.

sources.title: Market by order (MBO)
facts_used: MBO contains order events including add, cancel, modify, trade, fill, and clear.
MBO normalization can differ by venue and dataset.

sources.title: Market by price (MBP-10)
facts_used: MBP-10 contains every top-ten book event and aggregate depth.
MBP-10 can be derived from MBO.

sources.title: Common fields, enums and types
facts_used: Action N means no action and may carry flags or other information.
Side N means no side was specified.
F_LAST is 128 and marks the last record in an event for an instrument.
F_PUBLISHER_SPECIFIC is 2 and its semantics depend on publisher_id.
Flags describe event boundaries, message characteristics, or data quality.

sources.title: State management of resting orders
facts_used: A publisher event can normalize into multiple MBO records.
F_LAST identifies the last record for an instrument in an event.

sources.title: Databento release notes
facts_used: A None action variant was introduced for historical and live GLBX.MDP3 normalization.

official_semantics_review.documented_limit: The reviewed pages do not state that MBP-10 action, side, and flags must be a byte-for-byte copy of one originating MBO record.
official_semantics_review.inference_policy: Any conclusion beyond the cited field definitions is labeled LIKELY or UNRESOLVED rather than official fact.

residual_population_definition.step_3d_rule: Same K5, action, side, flags, and within-identical-metadata occurrence.
residual_population_definition.residual_condition: The requested one-based MBO occurrence does not exist under the exact Step 3D metadata tuple.

diagnostic_taxonomy.CONFIRMED: An exhaustive metadata count or invariant is reproduced identically by both implementations.
diagnostic_taxonomy.LIKELY: The metadata accounts for at least 95 percent but less than 100 percent of the stated population and is consistent with, but not explicitly guaranteed by, official semantics.
diagnostic_taxonomy.UNRESOLVED: The frozen threshold is not met, multiple interpretations remain, or official documentation does not establish the causal semantic rule.

tests: Reproduce the Step 3D exact metadata selector using metadata columns only.
Require exactly 2,552 residual vendor rows and require every residual to have a same-K5 MBO group.
Count source-order and group completeness invariants.
For every residual, count whether its action, side, flags, masked flags, and each pairwise combination occurs anywhere in the same-K5 MBO group.
Count exact and masked flag XOR distributions without timestamps, prices, sizes, or order IDs.
Cross-tabulate residual vendor action, side, flags, and depth.
Count same-K5 MBO group cardinality and action, side, and flags set cardinalities.
Compare vendor metadata with the first, last, and every F_LAST MBO record in the group.
Count F_LAST cardinality and whether the group contains publisher-specific, None-action, or None-side records.
Record metadata crosswalk counts from each residual vendor tuple to every same-K5 MBO action/side/flags tuple.
Apply every frozen candidate using metadata only and count available, unavailable, selected reuse, candidate cardinality, and occurrence shortfall.
Do not inspect or compare the book state selected by any candidate.
Classify each cause label using the frozen confidence definitions and supporting counts.
Distinguish official field definitions from empirical inference.
Record every negative and unresolved result.

frozen_candidate_registry.selector: Same K5, action, side, flags after clearing only bit 2 on vendor and MBO, then within-transformed-metadata occurrence.
Same K5, action, side, then within-identical-action-side occurrence; flags are not identity qualifiers.
Same K5 and action; require exact side only when vendor side is not N, treat vendor side N as unspecified, ignore flags, then within-transformed-metadata occurrence.
Same K5 and action, then within-identical-action occurrence; ignore side and flags.
Same K5 and within-K5 occurrence; ignore action, side, and flags.

candidate_occurrence_policy.vendor_order: One-based source_row_ordinal order inside the candidate's transformed vendor key.
candidate_occurrence_policy.mbo_order: One-based source_row_ordinal order inside the candidate's transformed MBO key.
candidate_occurrence_policy.selection: Vendor occurrence n selects only MBO occurrence n if it exists.

eligibility: Covers all 2,552 residual rows with no occurrence shortfall.
Selects no MBO row more than once.
Uses only the frozen metadata fields and transform.
Is consistent with the reviewed official definitions.
Is reproduced exactly by both implementations.
recommendation_rule.selection: Recommend the first eligible candidate in frozen ranking order.
recommendation_rule.if_none_eligible: Recommend no correction and classify header derivation as unresolved.

independent_reproduction.reference: Direct predicate filtering and occurrence counting within each same-K5 group.

prohibited: modifying any predecessor verdict or sealed artifact
loading price, size, order ID, or bid/ask book fields
selecting or ranking candidates using book equality
adding, removing, retuning, reordering, or repairing candidates after residual access
inspecting market outcomes or calculating directional relationships
